questions.explanation: True. S = v_i t + ½at² = 12(2) + ½(1)(2)² = 26 m.

questions.prompt: The vertical component of the velocity of a projectile is smallest (zero) at the highest point.
questions.explanation: True. v_y = v_i sinθ − gt = 0 at the top.

questions.prompt: A body brought to rest by brakes has an acceleration that is positive when the direction of motion is taken positive.
questions.explanation: False. It should read: A body brought to rest by brakes has an acceleration that is negative when the direction of motion is taken positive. Retardation opposes the motion, so with v positive a is negative.

questions.prompt: Y = ½gt² gives the vertical drop of a horizontally launched projectile after time t.
questions.explanation: True. The vertical drop is free fall from rest.

questions.prompt: A body moving at 2 m s⁻¹ and accelerates uniformly at 3 m s⁻² for 6 s. Its final velocity is 20 m s⁻¹.
questions.explanation: True. v_f = v_i + at = 2 + 3 × 6 = 20 m s⁻¹.

questions.prompt: A car moving at 4 m s⁻¹ and accelerates uniformly at 1 m s⁻² for 2 s. The distance travelled is 10 m.
questions.explanation: True. S = v_i t + ½at² = 4(2) + ½(1)(2)² = 10 m.

questions.prompt: In an elastic collision the total kinetic energy is conserved along with momentum.
questions.explanation: True. K before = K after.

questions.prompt: A body’s velocity changes uniformly from 0 m s⁻¹ to 45 m s⁻¹ in 9 s. Its acceleration is 5 m s⁻².
A body thrown into the air that then moves only under gravity is called a projectile.
questions.explanation: True. A projectile moves under gravity alone (air resistance neglected).

questions.prompt: Motion of a body from one place to another is called vibrational motion.
questions.explanation: False. It should read: Motion of a body from one place to another is called translational motion. In translational (translatory) motion the body as a whole changes its position.

questions.prompt: If a moving body slows down, the sign of its acceleration is opposite to the sign of its velocity.
questions.explanation: True. Retardation is acceleration opposite to the velocity, so it is negative when v is positive.

questions.prompt: A stone is dropped from a cliff 80 m high. Its speed on reaching the ground is 39.6 m s⁻¹.
A cricketer throws a ball at 14 m s⁻¹ at the angle that gives the greatest range on level ground. (g = 9.8 m s⁻²) The maximum range is 20 m.
questions.explanation: True. R_max = v_i²/g = 14²/9.8 = 20 m (at 45°).

questions.prompt: Launch angles of 20° and 70° give equal ranges at the same speed.
questions.explanation: True. They are complementary.

questions.prompt: The area under a velocity–time graph gives the distance (displacement).
questions.explanation: True. Area = v × t summed over the motion = distance travelled.

questions.prompt: A body accelerates uniformly at 5 m s⁻² from 10 m s⁻¹ to 30 m s⁻¹. The time taken is 6 s.
A projectile is launched at 25 m s⁻¹ at 45° above the horizontal. (g = 9.8 m s⁻²) Its time of flight is 3.61 s.
A ball is thrown vertically upward at 24.5 m s⁻¹. (g = 9.8 m s⁻²) The maximum height reached is 15.3 m.
The time of flight of a projectile launched with speed v_i at angle θ (level ground) is 2v_i sinθ / g.
questions.explanation: True. T = 2 × (time to the top) = 2v_i sinθ/g.

questions.prompt: The acceleration due to gravity is directed horizontally.
questions.explanation: False. It should read: The acceleration due to gravity is directed towards the centre of the Earth. g points toward the centre of the Earth (vertically downward at the surface).

questions.prompt: For a ball thrown vertically upward (upward positive), the acceleration at every point is −g.
questions.explanation: True. Gravity always acts downward, so a = −g all along.

questions.prompt: The same three equations of motion are used for free fall by replacing a with g.
questions.explanation: True. a = g = 9.8 m s⁻².

questions.prompt: A projectile is launched at 40 m s⁻¹ at 30° above the horizontal. (g = 9.8 m s⁻²) Its time of flight is 7.07 s.
When there is no net external force on a system, its total momentum is conserved.
questions.explanation: True. F = Δp/Δt = 0 means Δp = 0.

questions.prompt: A body moving at 5 m s⁻¹ and accelerates uniformly at 1 m s⁻² for 6 s. Its final velocity is 17 m s⁻¹.
questions.explanation: False. v_f = v_i + at = 5 + 1 × 6 = 11 m s⁻¹.

questions.prompt: A body accelerates uniformly at 4 m s⁻² from 3 m s⁻¹ to 27 m s⁻¹. The time taken is 6 s.
A projectile is launched at 15 m s⁻¹ at 60° above the horizontal. (g = 9.8 m s⁻²) The vertical component of the launch velocity is 15 m s⁻¹.
questions.explanation: False. v_iy = v_i sinθ = 15 sin60° = 13 m s⁻¹.

questions.prompt: The SI unit of momentum is kg m s⁻¹.
questions.explanation: True. p = m v: kg × m s⁻¹. It is the same as N s.

questions.prompt: A car moving at 6 m s⁻¹ and accelerates uniformly at 2 m s⁻² for 5 s. The distance travelled is 25 m.
questions.explanation: False. S = v_i t + ½at² = 6(5) + ½(2)(5)² = 55 m.

questions.prompt: The maximum height of a projectile launched with speed v_i at angle θ is v_i sinθ / g.
questions.explanation: False. It should read: The maximum height of a projectile launched with speed v_i at angle θ is v_i² sin²θ / 2g. H = (v_i sinθ)²/2g.

questions.prompt: A car starts from rest and accelerates uniformly at 3 m s⁻² for 4 s. The distance travelled is 24 m.
questions.explanation: True. S = v_i t + ½at² = 0(4) + ½(3)(4)² = 24 m.

questions.prompt: For a body starting from rest, v_i = 0 in the equations of motion.
questions.explanation: True. Starting from rest means the initial velocity is zero.

questions.prompt: The maximum height of a body thrown vertically upward with speed v_i is 2v_i/g.
questions.explanation: False. It should read: The maximum height of a body thrown vertically upward with speed v_i is v_i²/2g. Third equation with v_f = 0 and a = −g.

questions.prompt: The path of a projectile in the absence of air resistance is a parabola.
questions.explanation: True. Uniform horizontal motion plus uniformly accelerated vertical motion gives a parabola.

questions.prompt: A body moving at 2 m s⁻¹ and accelerates uniformly at 5 m s⁻² for 4 s. Its final velocity is 22 m s⁻¹.
questions.explanation: True. v_f = v_i + at = 2 + 5 × 4 = 22 m s⁻¹.

questions.prompt: A projectile is launched at 50 m s⁻¹ at 37° above the horizontal. (g = 9.8 m s⁻²) Its time of flight is 18.42 s.
A projectile is launched at 15 m s⁻¹ at 30° above the horizontal. (g = 9.8 m s⁻²) Its time of flight is 1.53 s.
A car moving at 4 m s⁻¹ and accelerates uniformly at 4 m s⁻² for 6 s. The distance travelled is 96 m.
questions.explanation: True. S = v_i t + ½at² = 4(6) + ½(4)(6)² = 96 m.

questions.prompt: A ball is thrown horizontally at 12 m s⁻¹ from a height of 19.6 m. (g = 9.8 m s⁻²) It hits the ground with a speed of 19.6 m s⁻¹.
A body starts from rest and accelerates uniformly at 3 m s⁻² for 8 s. Its final velocity is 24 m s⁻¹.
questions.explanation: True. v_f = v_i + at = 0 + 3 × 8 = 24 m s⁻¹.

questions.prompt: In an explosion, the kinetic energy of the system increases.
questions.explanation: True. Stored chemical or elastic energy is released.

questions.prompt: A projectile is launched at 20 m s⁻¹ at 60° above the horizontal. (g = 9.8 m s⁻²) Its maximum height is 15.3 m.
questions.explanation: True. H = v_i² sin²θ/2g = 20² sin²60°/19.6 = 15.3 m.

questions.prompt: A car starts from rest and accelerates uniformly at 2 m s⁻² for 8 s. The distance travelled is 0 m.
questions.explanation: False. S = v_i t + ½at² = 0(8) + ½(2)(8)² = 64 m.

questions.prompt: A body accelerates uniformly at 5 m s⁻² from 0 m s⁻¹ to 30 m s⁻¹. The time taken is 6 s.
Momentum is a vector quantity.
questions.explanation: True. Its direction is the direction of the velocity.

questions.prompt: For two complementary launch angles with the same speed, the one with the larger angle has the longer time of flight.
questions.explanation: True. T ∝ sinθ.

questions.prompt: Two bodies exert forces on each other during a collision. These forces are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction.
questions.explanation: True. Newton’s third law, so the total momentum change is zero.

questions.prompt: A projectile launched at 40° with a speed of 35 m s⁻¹ has a range of 123.1 m. The same speed gives the same range at 50 °.
questions.explanation: True. Complementary angle: 90° − 40° = 50°.

questions.prompt: A projectile is launched at 10 m s⁻¹ at 37° above the horizontal. (g = 9.8 m s⁻²) Its maximum height is 1.8 m.
questions.explanation: True. H = v_i² sin²θ/2g = 10² sin²37°/19.6 = 1.8 m.

questions.prompt: Brakes give a car moving at 12 m s⁻¹ a retardation of 4 m s⁻². It takes 4 s to stop.
questions.explanation: False. 0 = v_i − at gives t = v_i/a = 12/4 = 3 s.

questions.prompt: A car moving at 10 m s⁻¹ and accelerates uniformly at 3 m s⁻² for 5 s. The distance travelled is 50 m.
questions.explanation: False. S = v_i t + ½at² = 10(5) + ½(3)(5)² = 87.5 m.

questions.prompt: A ball is thrown horizontally at 25 m s⁻¹ from a height of 44.1 m. (g = 9.8 m s⁻²) It strikes the ground at 49.6 ° below the horizontal.
questions.explanation: True. tanθ = v_fy/v_fx = 29.4/25, so θ = 49.6°.

questions.prompt: A body starts from rest and accelerates uniformly at 3 m s⁻² for 4 s. Its final velocity is −12 m s⁻¹.
questions.explanation: False. v_f = v_i + at = 0 + 3 × 4 = 12 m s⁻¹.
